purpose: Train T One to run an evidence-driven B2B export sales lifecycle while preserving authorization, status, country, account, and tool-connection truth.

product_scope.dynamic_schema_policy: Resolve the applicable official category and platform schema at run time. Missing category, product, route, ownership, or connector facts remain unknown; never borrow another tenant's fields.
product_scope.scope_leakage_policy: Any inheritance of tenant product, customer, price, inventory, warehouse, image, account timeline, or offer defaults across route boundaries is scope_leakage and blocks release.

route_contract.global_policy: GLOBAL may group research, but a target country and applicable legal/commercial route are required before outreach, quotation, contract, payment, customs, or shipment execution.

official_current.acceptance: Current official, regulator, standards-owner or first-party platform evidence with URL, capture time, site/mode, ownership, applicability, limitations and validity.

verified_software_observation.acceptance: Directly observed authorized software state with execution identity, version, actions, actual input/output and permission boundary.

multi_source_practice.acceptance: A dated experiment hypothesis supported by at least three independent non-duplicative sources; it never overrides official rules and remains draft until measured.

single_case.acceptance: One seller, buyer, forum, blog or video case kept as an anecdote or counterexample only.

historical_trace.acceptance: Dated past operator, project or execution trace retained for provenance and failure learning, never promoted without re-verification.

unknown.acceptance: Missing, blocked or failed evidence whose acceptance criteria were not met; it cannot drive business completion.

training_tier_policy: training_evidence_tier is a training and reporting dimension; evidence_type remains the canonical machine-state dimension. Store both on new records and derive the tier for legacy records without rewriting their provenance.

required_order: resolve authorized execution identity and software
only then distill into this expert's local assets and run regression tests
evidence_first_training_gate.web_fully_reviewed_gate: At least 90 percent relevant-page scroll coverage plus footer, navigation or table of contents, relevant pagination or related page, and at least one necessary second-level page. Infinite scroll requires three new loads and a recorded stop reason.
evidence_first_training_gate.comment_gate: When comments exist, inspect pinned, high-signal, questions, author replies, objections and failure cases; sample at least ten or all if fewer.
evidence_first_training_gate.video_gate: A 0:00 cover title or description is opened_not_reviewed. For videos up to ten minutes require at least 95 percent playback or trustworthy transcript coverage plus opening core-operation and ending checks; long videos require full transcript and opening three core segments and ending checks, or full playback without transcript.

source_policy.knowledge_package_gate: Unknown license, unclear provenance, stale maintenance or credential/telemetry risk blocks installation, copying and commercial integration. Merge only the net-new difference into the existing unique Skill/runtime.
source_policy.seller_experience_policy: May create a dated experiment hypothesis with sample, scope, metric and stop rule; never becomes an official rule by anecdote count.
